loadable_lehami_weights.wording: No publicly downloadable LeHami checkpoint found in the verified official sources; this does not establish that the authors have no private checkpoints.
loadable_lehami_weights.eval_only: Official helpers require a local best.ckpt under STABLEWM_HOME/checkpoints; no LeHami checkpoint downloader was found.

conservative_latents.content: Encoded and predicted latent q/p/z, latent H, episode/time indices, and reference physical states; not trainable network weights or a directly executable model.

recorded_demos.scope: Author-recorded outputs, not live reruns. Reversal caption says EXP067 at zero action,20steps +dt and20steps -dt.

available.dinov2: Download script fetches a pretrained DINOv2 visual encoder, not a trained LeHami dynamics model.

downloaded_official_assets: references/lehami_official_assets_20261029; four selected author files verified against pinned Git blob hashes
recommended_exact_reproduction_entry: lehami/experiments/conservative_multi_rod.sh, a0m and b0m; original configurations/manifests/evaluation unchanged
limitations: Direct hosted project webpage was inaccessible through web fetch; its complete public GitHub source and assets tree were inspected instead.
